name: Beijing Urban Construction Design & Development Group Co., Limited
summary: Founded in 1958 and based in Wanchai, Hong Kong, Beijing Urban Construction Design & Development Group provides infrastructure construction services in China and abroad. Its two divisions are design, survey and consultancy, serving urban rail transit, industrial and civil projects, and construction contracting, including BOT concessions. It also does engineering consulting, testing, property management and railway operation management. Until 2013 it was Beijing Urban Construction Design & Research Institute.
